title: MITRE T1543.003 / T1136.001 / T1070.001 Persistence & Anti-Forensics Playbook
description: Reference workflow for investigating Windows service creation (4697), local account creation (4720), privileged group modification (4732), audit policy tampering (4719), and security event log clearing (1102).
approval_requirements: Tier 2 Lead & Incident Commander approval required for host isolation and privileged account revocation.
closure_requirements: Requires service binary hash verification, unauthorized account disablement receipt, and off-host SIEM log backup preservation.

steps.step_name: Inspect New Windows Service Creation (Event ID 4697)
steps.step_description: Verify ServiceName, ServiceFileName path, and binary signature for newly registered services.

steps.step_name: Audit Account Creation & Privileged Group Escalation (4720 / 4732)
steps.step_description: Correlate newly created local/domain accounts and additions to Administrators group.

steps.step_name: Assess Audit Policy Tampering & Log Clear (4719 / 1102)
steps.step_description: Verify whether system audit policy was weakened prior to Event ID 1102 Security log clear and recover off-host SIEM telemetry.

steps.step_name: Isolate Host, Disable Rogue Account & Remove Malicious Service
steps.step_description: Contain affected host, disable unauthorized account (support_temp), and remove persistence service.
Record complete attack chain and link preserved off-host evidence references.
